sourceDisclosure: SEC Rule 605 FAQ is staff interpretation effective August 1, 2026, not new law. Its FAQ 39 odd-lot price-improvement data collection begins Nov 1, 2026. OCC June 2024 Options Disclosure Document is current in the pages checked; OIC examples are educational, not personalized strategy advice.

rule605.claimTitle: Different venues can display different prices at the same apparent moment
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Rule 605 uses consolidated order-time benchmarks; it does not verify every apparent local venue quote or its usable share depth.
rule605.limitation: Venue quote origin, eligibility and timestamp required

rule605.claimTitle: A print at a displayed bid does not prove the seller's motive
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Trade price location does not establish a participant's position, identity or motive; platform heuristics remain unverified by the FAQ.

rule605.claimTitle: The quote midpoint is arithmetic, not necessarily an available order price
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Rule 605 midpoint benchmarks use NBBO prices; an arithmetic midpoint is not an execution guarantee.

rule605.claimTitle: Locked and crossed quote states require explicit validity handling
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: FAQ 19 explicitly prescribes handling crossed/locked NBBO for certain reporting benchmarks; it is not a universal market-clearing rule.

rule605.claimTitle: Not every visible quote is automatically part of a protected NBBO
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: FAQ 39 distinguishes NBBO from best available displayed price including qualifying odd lots. The 2026-11-01 collection milestone must be preserved.
rule605.limitation: Do not call any platform indication an eligible protected national quote

rule605.claimTitle: A later-arriving quote is not necessarily the quote active at trade execution
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: FAQ 34 requires plan-processor dissemination timestamps for Rule 605 NBBO statistics; arbitrary feed arrival order is not a sufficient reconstructed execution benchmark.
rule605.limitation: Exchange, reporting and plan timestamps differ

rule605.claimTitle: The number of tape prints is not traded share volume
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Rule 605 distinguishes order counts and share-weighted statistics, but cannot serve as a complete guide to trade-feed print aggregation or correction conditions.
rule605.limitation: Count and volume are separate units; data feed event model required

rule605.claimTitle: Time-and-sales colors are display rules, not verified buyer intentions
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Green, red and white print colors are vendor display conventions; SEC Rule 605 does not define trader motive from chart colors.
rule605.limitation: Document actual Chart Studio classification and label uncertain/midpoint

rule605.claimTitle: A one-sided market cannot supply a conventional two-sided quoted spread
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Without simultaneous eligible bid and offer, a two-sided quote midpoint and spread are undefined; Rule 605 statistics assume valid qualifying quote benchmarks.
rule605.limitation: Require both sides and timestamp alignment

rule605.claimTitle: Quoted spread and effective spread use different reference quantities
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: FAQ 37 discusses executed-share-weighted midpoint/quoted/effective/realized spread statistics; the illustration uses a separate confirmed buy fill.
rule605.limitation: Confirm correct effective-spread denominator and side

rule605.claimTitle: Price improvement is relative to a defined eligible quote, not yesterday's close
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Rule 605 FAQ addresses price improvement relative to applicable quotes and odd-lot eligibility; this is a teaching example, not an official monthly report.
rule605.limitation: Use quote effective at the right event time

rule605.claimTitle: An indicative annual borrow fee is not a one-day interest amount
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: SEC short-sale investor bulletin confirms stock-loan interest is a potential cost; the chosen 360-day simple convention is a declared hypothetical, not official universal broker policy.
rule605.limitation: Verify broker agreements for actual loan balance, rate and day-count

rule605.claimTitle: Slippage cannot be interpreted without a declared decision-price benchmark
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Rule 605 has order-time benchmarking, but a member's slippage definition needs a distinct decision/reference price, verified fill and transaction costs.
rule605.limitation: Treat $8 figure as a declared comparison only

rule605.claimTitle: Realized spread depends on a posttrade midpoint at a specified future horizon
rule605.reference: SEC Rule 605 April 1 2026 staff FAQ effective 2026-08-01
rule605.specificSourceFinding: Realized spread involves a specified later midpoint and applies retrospectively; future midpoint must never appear to the original replay decision.
rule605.limitation: Prevent hindsight leak and time-horizon mismatch
